title: R67 Deep Dive implementation handoff
scope: 22 assigned view/data requirements plus 4 shared Mix integration contracts; not a claim of 26 native browser passes

requirements.requirement: By Item defaults to a compact table, with Cards as an alternative and grouping off.
requirements.implementation: Table/cards use the same filtered canonical SKU rows. Grouping defaults off. Recovered DataGrid and Impact controls preserve identity, selection, typed filters and personal columns; 72 cards are paginated.
requirements.limits: Source/model/parse evidence does not prove actual browser rendering, focus motion or saved browser downloads.

requirements.requirement: Pin identity, provide sales/stock, velocity/exposure and lifecycle/focus presets plus columns/export.
requirements.implementation: Sales/stock, velocity/exposure, lifecycle/focus and source-parity presets; searchable aliases; locked identity on desktop and unpinned narrow layout. Controlled sort uses stable IDs and unavailable-last ordering. Data export follows current filtered/sorted aggregate rows; a separate worksheet retains exact contributing pairs.
requirements.limits: Source/model/parse evidence does not prove actual browser rendering, focus motion or saved browser downloads.

requirements.requirement: Ranged stores per SKU and chain total use different distinct grains.
requirements.implementation: Main counts use the canonical 72-SKU/45-store ledger. Footer/summary distinct union is recomputed from leaves, not summed store breadth. Original 4×4 specification figures remain algorithm controls in the data agent’s separate tests, not fabricated current main rows.
requirements.limits: Source/model/parse evidence does not prove actual browser rendering, focus motion or saved browser downloads.

requirements.requirement: Expose qualifying numerator and pair-week denominator next to velocity.
requirements.implementation: Velocity preset shows qualifying ranged quantity, total net quantity, ranged pair-weeks and computed velocity. Filtered totals expose the same numerator/denominator and recomputed ratio.
requirements.limits: Source/model/parse evidence does not prove actual browser rendering, focus motion or saved browser downloads.

requirements.requirement: Keep full identity, productivity, inventory, range, lifecycle and decision column groups with exact legacy aliases.
requirements.implementation: MIP, MIP Sales By Location, PWPS, ELP, VP Avg and Active Assorted remain searchable exact source aliases with Definition pending. OH CST$ points to OH cost. No guessed expansion or source-definition approval is claimed; denied margin values remain restricted and are removed by workbook permissions.
requirements.limits: Source/model/parse evidence does not prove actual browser rendering, focus motion or saved browser downloads.

requirements.requirement: Provide Performance, Stores, PLR history, Actions and notes inside Item Detail.
requirements.implementation: Performance, Stores, PLR history and Actions/notes share a canonical SKU anchor. Current-range and all-candidate store lenses are explicit. Local interval/pair selection remains visible and removable.
requirements.limits: Source/model/parse evidence does not prove actual browser rendering, focus motion or saved browser downloads.

requirements.requirement: Both drill directions use the same pair facts and preserve state.
requirements.implementation: Item→Stores→shared Pair→full Store assortment clears the local SKU/pair restriction while retaining local fiscal interval and global applied scope; originating SKU is only a highlight. Context snapshots restore table search/sort/columns/group/page/selection; the table also records native grid scroll positions.
requirements.limits: Source/model/parse evidence does not prove actual browser rendering, focus motion or saved browser downloads.

requirements.requirement: Never infer member identities from company facts or aggregate breadth counts.
requirements.implementation: Unknown range history is labeled. Breadth identity drill disables when membership is unknown or matched LY date is absent. Aggregate source report fields remain definition-pending; no aggregate count creates invented canonical members.
requirements.limits: Source/model/parse evidence does not prove actual browser rendering, focus motion or saved browser downloads.

requirements.requirement: Store table is primary; optional map uses real metric scales and navigates to store detail.
requirements.implementation: Primary sortable store table is fully implemented. Geographic map is explicitly unavailable because canonical masters do not contain approved coordinates/boundaries. No inferred geography or false metric scale is drawn.
requirements.limits: Source/model/parse evidence does not prove actual browser rendering, focus motion or saved browser downloads.

requirements.requirement: Only show governed dated cluster summaries.
requirements.implementation: A–F source labels support grouping and scoped search. Governed dated targets are not connected, so actual/target/pp-gap summary is disabled with a reason rather than generated as an approved comparison.
requirements.limits: Source/model/parse evidence does not prove actual browser rendering, focus motion or saved browser downloads.

requirements.requirement: By Store begins with a sortable store table with search/group/columns/export and comparison.
requirements.implementation: Recovered DataGrid provides the store index; typed local conditions, search, region/district/cluster grouping, columns, exact exports and direct single-store detail. Aggregates use the same item-store leaves as By Item.
requirements.limits: Source/model/parse evidence does not prove actual browser rendering, focus motion or saved browser downloads.

requirements.requirement: Assortment is Store Detail default with a single-store anchor and Change store.
requirements.implementation: Assortment defaults; Change store is explicit. Product/time/snapshot filters persist. Population choices are inherited, current range, all eligible, exited and all candidates. Zero-sales ranged and stocked exited pairs are retained by canonical selectors.
requirements.limits: Source/model/parse evidence does not prove actual browser rendering, focus motion or saved browser downloads.

requirements.requirement: Provide Performance, Focus and actions, External reports beside Assortment.
requirements.implementation: Assortment, Performance, Focus/actions and External reports. Highcharts trend uses exact fiscal points and an accessible data alternative; local week selection is removable and drills without changing the applied PLR prefix. Named top-20 ranking uses canonical ties. External feed needs/source grain are disclosed; no traffic or competition values are invented.
requirements.limits: Source/model/parse evidence does not prove actual browser rendering, focus motion or saved browser downloads.

requirements.requirement: Compare two to five stores on the same measures and exposure window.
requirements.implementation: 2–5 stores are enforced; selected stores can be removed and comparison measure changed. All cards use the same product/date scope, open store-weeks and ratio definitions. Format/space comparability remains explicitly not connected.
requirements.limits: Source/model/parse evidence does not prove actual browser rendering, focus motion or saved browser downloads.

requirements.requirement: Provide Range/stock, Sales and Coverage modes over dated canonical SKU-store cells.
requirements.implementation: Range/stock, net sales and backward R4 WOS share one canonical pair map. Search rows/columns, explicit all-candidates option, pair selection/comparison, scoped review and shared detail. Original PLR remains a fixed cohort.
requirements.limits: Source/model/parse evidence does not prove actual browser rendering, focus motion or saved browser downloads.

requirements.requirement: Match the proposed coherent baseline range state matrix.
requirements.implementation: Main UI now uses 72×45 canonical identities. The original P101/P104 four-item matrix is retained solely as a separately passing data algorithm control. Every main cell state comes from dated canonical facts.
requirements.limits: Source/model/parse evidence does not prove actual browser rendering, focus motion or saved browser downloads.

requirements.requirement: Provide Breadth TY/LY with product/geography grouping and source/governed count labels.
requirements.implementation: Distinct TY/LY and signed delta use the same canonical membership set. Product grouping and Store/Region/District/Cluster grouping use distinct unions; TY and mapped LY dates are visible. Locations and member pairs are paginated, with dated source-member drill.

requirements.requirement: Handle unknown, missing, valid zero and negative inventory distinctly.
requirements.implementation: Unknown has patterned state text, valid zero remains R0 only when ranged, negative stock is reconciliation, outside-population cells are explicitly excluded and unavailable metrics never become zero. Unknown/unauthorized selections cannot enter bulk review.

requirements.requirement: Bound large grids, keep pinned labels and support keyboard plus narrow pair-list alternative.
requirements.implementation: Explicit 5/10-item and 5/10-store pages cover all 72×45 identities; no hidden slice. Arrows cross page boundaries and Enter opens pair evidence; Escape clears selection. Narrow layout uses a separately paginated pair list. Grid labels are pinned on desktop.

requirements.requirement: Provide Performance, Availability, Range history and Decisions in shared pair detail.
requirements.implementation: Shared canonical pair detail contains Performance, Availability/supply, Range/PLR history and Decisions/notes. Exact local interval and scope filters apply consistently; observed facts, hypotheses and follow-up decisions are separate.

requirements.requirement: Store, inbound, allocation and DC pool are different grains and availability states.
requirements.implementation: Physical store inventory, sellable stock, open orders/ETA and shared DC pool references stay separate grains. Recovered evidence grids preserve source IDs/dates/UOM/allocation. Separate source-ledger exports are offered; no inbound or DC pool is added to today’s sellable stock.

dataBoundary: 72 canonical products × 45 stores. Main demo facts are illustrative; original four-SKU numeric examples remain separately tested algorithm controls. External coordinates, governed cluster targets, original client alias definitions and real execution feeds are not fabricated.
nativeChecksRecommended: Full item table/cards and three table presets; search aliases PWPS / OH CST$; between/missing/nonpositive filters, AND/OR and invalid bounds.
Item name→Stores→pair→full store assortment→Back, checking exact values, local interval, original scope, selected columns/page/scroll and highlight.
Matrix final item page (items 71–72) and final store page (stores 41–45); arrows across paging boundary, selection count, unknown disable and normalized export.
At 390px: pair-list paging, item/store grids without frozen lead columns, metric filter/chooser controls, store comparison and supply ledger reachability.
Breadth product/geography grouping, explicit TY/LY dates, unknown disabled drill, signed deltas, chain distinct union and member history.
Compare 2 and 5 stores, reject 1 and 6; change measure/remove a store; exact scoped store-week productivity.
Actual native aggregate export after filtering/sorting/preset change: Data row order, Scope/Definitions, Contributing pairs, source IDs/UOM/dates and restricted-margin exclusion.
Detail trend week/month/metric selection, local interval drill and clear, keeping the applied original PLR period pinned.
